questions.prompt: What does the slope of a time-series line represent?
questions.answer: Change in the vertical quantity per unit of time.
questions.feedback: Check the definition and explain it in your own words before retrying.

questions.prompt: Does a rising line with falling slope mean the level falls?
questions.answer: No; the level can increase at a diminishing rate.
questions.feedback: Check the distinction or calculation against the worked case; correct the first unsupported step.

questions.answer: Grouping choices can change the displayed distribution.
questions.feedback: State a concrete implication or limitation and retry without notes.

scoring.knowledge: 1 point per correct answer; formative only.
scoring.practice: Accurately extracts levels and changes and identifies misleading graphical choices.
scoring.transfer: Compare two representations of the same fictional dataset, one using a zero baseline and one zoomed. State the question each answers, and propose a clearer label for the scale.
scoring.pass: All mapped criteria require Level 2 evidence; quiz score alone is insufficient.
